input.video_prompt: A colored-pencil drawing on cream paper comes to life, still a hand-drawn pencil drawing in every frame: the same fine pencil lines, the same paper texture and soft hatching as the first frame, never a photo, never 3D. Static locked-off camera, no zoom, no push-in, framing exactly as in the first frame. No captions, no subtitles, no new text, no new objects.
